limitations: FTA event leaves must explicitly consume the declared cause and all affected events.
Caller must classify shared-cause occurrence and affected event set with evidence.
Joint count completeness and grouping unit are caller-reviewed; this adapter does not infer causality or independence.
Owner FTA must validate request and evidence before any result is accepted.
Receipt replay revalidates the embedded count table and checks joint states, event evidence and dependency groups; it remains a lineage check, not proof that source observations are true.
